hints.title: Effective Index Parity
hints.text: Whenever an element is deleted, the effective index of all subsequent elements decreases by 1.

hints.title: Greedy Pairing Condition
hints.text: When the effective index (i - deleted) is even, the current element cannot equal nums[i + 1]. If it does, deleting nums[i] is mandatory.

hints.title: Trailing Odd Length Check
hints.text: After processing all adjacent comparisons, if the remaining number of elements is odd, delete one final element to ensure even length.

hints.title: Greedy Deletion Pass

complexity.notes: Single pass with running deleted counter.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all combinations of deletions results in exponential branches.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate tracks virtual index shift and handles final odd parity.
